title: A Delivery Complaint
summary: A customer complains about a delayed and damaged delivery while negotiating a fair solution.

lines.speaker: Bruno
lines.pt: Central de atendimento, boa tarde. Aqui é o Bruno. Em que posso ajudar?
lines.en: Customer service center, good afternoon. This is Bruno. How can I help?

lines.speaker: Carla
lines.pt: Boa tarde, Bruno. Recebi minha encomenda com três dias de atraso e a caixa chegou amassada.
lines.en: Good afternoon, Bruno. I received my order three days late and the box arrived crushed.

lines.speaker: Bruno
lines.pt: Sinto muito pelo transtorno. O produto foi danificado?
lines.en: I am sorry for the inconvenience. Was the product damaged?

lines.speaker: Carla
lines.pt: Sim. A cafeteira liga, mas vaza água pela base. Tirei fotos antes de abrir a embalagem.
lines.en: Yes. The coffee maker turns on, but leaks water from the base. I took photos before opening the package.

lines.speaker: Bruno
lines.pt: As fotos ajudam bastante. Você pode anexá-las ao formulário que vou enviar?
lines.en: The photos help a lot. Can you attach them to the form I will send?

lines.speaker: Carla
lines.pt: Posso, mas preciso de uma solução rápida. Era presente para minha irmã.
lines.en: I can, but I need a quick solution. It was a gift for my sister.

lines.speaker: Bruno
lines.pt: Entendo. Podemos oferecer troca ou reembolso integral.
lines.en: I understand. We can offer an exchange or a full refund.

lines.speaker: Carla
lines.pt: Prefiro a troca, desde que o novo envio seja mais rápido.
lines.en: I prefer an exchange, as long as the new shipment is faster.

lines.speaker: Bruno
lines.pt: Vou solicitar envio expresso sem custo adicional e enviar um código de postagem para devolução.
lines.en: I will request express shipping at no additional cost and send a postage code for the return.

lines.speaker: Carla
lines.pt: Tudo bem. Por favor, registre o protocolo da reclamação.
lines.en: All right. Please register the complaint protocol number.

lines.speaker: Bruno
lines.pt: Protocolo 4582. Vou acompanhar o caso até a nova entrega sair.
lines.en: Protocol 4582. I will follow the case until the new delivery goes out.

comprehension.question: What happened to the delivery?
options: It was sent to a store
It contained the wrong color only

comprehension.question: What is wrong with the coffee maker?
options: It leaks water from the base
comprehension.answer: It leaks water from the base

comprehension.question: What solution does the customer prefer?
What shipping will the company request?
options: Express shipping at no additional cost
comprehension.answer: Express shipping at no additional cost
